text_block_list.text:
Contrary to our pre-race anxieties, Gold 
Ship showed us a powerful performance!

With this, we can hold high hopes for 
upcoming races. Now is the time to set the 
next goal and stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Soy, soy, soy, soy!! Sooooooooy, SOY!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Are you eating your soybeans?! Are you 
getting enough protein?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The nutrients you take in build your body! 
Golshi-chan's success is all thanks to 
soybeans!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So you better thank soybeans, too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get energized and refine 
some soy milk today, too!

Before we can talk about our next goal, 
Gold Ship is already trying to leave...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
choice_data_list: What kind of race do you want to run next?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's this, so out of the blue? Mr. 
Sudden-Shock-Collision, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't care as long as it's hot. Just so 
long as it ain't lukewarm like fresh curry 
udon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave mochi to the mochi maker, and udon 
to the udon shop. So do what you do best 
and handle it for me. Catch ya later!

I'm not quite sure what is being asked of 
me, but...

If it's a race that makes use of her 
long-distance aptitude, it's sure to fire 
her up.

First, let's aim for something like the 
Hopeful Stakes...!
